purpose: Known-answer corpus: every entry is measured by the engine in CI and asserted against either an exact-by-construction value, a published value, or a dated engine baseline (regression, never truth). No entry without provenance.
band_policy: Cost-level coverage gates activate when >=3 REAL paired quotes exist for a family; until then the gates enforce the UNCALIBRATED label and the wide assumption band (tests/test_weldment_costing.py, tests/test_pressure_screen.py).

pending_contributions.how: open any part in Fusion 360 -> File -> Export -> STEP; commit under backend/tests/assets/known-answer/ with a README line recording the Fusion version and settings
